chunks: That day man will say: 'Where can I find escape?'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about man's cry for escape on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This verse, from Surah Al-Qiyamah, captures the existential panic of the disbeliever who, having exhausted all worldly avenues, realizes there is no escape from Divine Justice. In Shia exegesis, this moment underscores the finality of accountability, contrasting the fleeting nature of worldly power with the absolute sovereignty of Allah. It serves as a poignant reminder that true refuge is found only in preparation for the Hereafter through faith and righteous deeds.
